evidence.answer: Contemporaneous reports linked the allegation to Macron’s description of the murder of teacher Samuel Paty as an Islamist terrorist attack. On October 16, 2020, after the killing, Macron said at Conflans-Sainte-Honorine that Paty had been the victim of an “attentat terroriste islamiste caractérisé,” or a clear Islamist terrorist attack; Paty had shown pupils cartoons of the Prophet Muhammad during a discussion of free speech. In Proposed amendments to the Commission’s false or misleading news provisions, Broadcasting Regulatory Policy CRTC 2011-308, 11 May 2011, the Commission stated that given the protections afforded by section 2(b) of the Canadian Charter of Rights and Freedoms and the objectives set out in the Broadcasting Act, the breach of these provisions must be flagrant for the Commission to take action on a complaint.

evidence.question: Is the U.S. Fox News television channel currently available to viewers in Canada through authorized television providers?
evidence.answer: Rogers Cable has added US cable network Fox News Channel to its lineup of digital channels. According to Rogers, it is the first cable company to carry this channel in Canada.
